title: A Hasidic Jew Protested Against an Israeli Flag. He May Be Deported.
summary_full: Yehonatan Ovadia, who opposed the mounting of the flag in a small New York town, belongs to a Hasidic branch that is anti-Zionist. He is now in ICE custody.
